text: 2nd International Vietnam Rice Industry Festival 2026 opens in Cần Thơ

HÀ NỘI - The 2nd International Vietnam Rice Industry Festival 2026 with the theme 'Green Vietnamese Rice - Reaching the Global Stage' is taking place in Cần Thơ City to enhance the value of Vietnamese rice and affirm its position in the international market.

At the opening ceremony of the four-day event, National Assembly President Trần Thanh Mẫn said rice had long been central to Việt Nam's wet-rice civilisation, underpinning its prosperity and shaping its cultural identity.
He highlighted the Mekong Delta's vital role as the country's main rice-producing region, contributing to food security at home and abroad.

Việt Nam has progressively enhanced the quality of its rice products, developing aromatic, specialty and organic varieties to meet the increasingly demanding standards of various international markets.
The NA President praised the contributions of millions of farmers, cooperatives, officials, scientists, experts and businesses to the development of the rice sector.

He called for a shift from exporting agricultural commodities to exporting agricultural technology, saying Việt Nam should go beyond selling rice, coffee and cashews to sharing its expertise, production models and technologies with the world.
This would help create greater added value and raise the country's standing internationally.

Amid new requirements and challenges, he urged Cần Thơ City to step up its green transition and climate change adaptation, promoting circular farming, digitalisation and the application of advanced technologies, including AI, to cut costs, use resources more efficiently, protect the environment and reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

Furthermore, he called for the strengthening of the four-party linkage model that involves the State, farmers, scientists, and businesses, while placing a strong focus on building and protecting the Vietnamese rice brand to enhance both quality and international competitiveness.

The Chairman also expressed a desire for continued cooperation, technology transfer, and investment from international partners, all of which will contribute to the development of an ecological agricultural sector, modern rural areas, and a sophisticated, progressive farming community.

Đỗ Thanh Bình, secretary of the Cần Thơ City Party Committee and head of the Cần Thơ City National Assembly Deputies Delegation, said that the festival is not only an event to honour achievements and promote the image of Việt Nam, its land, people, and culture, but also a forum for connecting knowledge, technology, markets and development resources.

The city expects these activities to forge substantive links between raw material production areas and processing enterprises, distributors, and markets; between the scientific community and production needs; and between investors and potential projects.
Furthermore, it seeks to expand international cooperation in developing a green, high-quality, and low-emission rice sector.
Cần Thơ City is committed to continuing its support for enterprises, investors, international organisations, and partners.
This includes improving the investment and business climate, accelerating administrative reform, and developing infrastructure and human resources.

The city also intends to strengthen coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development, research institutes, universities, international partners and other localities in the region to promote research, technology transfer, the development of raw material production areas, brand building and the expansion of markets for Vietnamese rice.

The festival, which is organised by the Cần Thơ City People's Committee in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development, is bringing together approximately 500 exhibitors and organisations, including regulatory bodies, international entities, experts, scientists, businesses, cooperatives, and farmers from both Việt Nam and abroad.
The event aims to honour achievements in agricultural development and promote Việt Nam's rice heritage.
It also seeks to affirm the strengths and standing of the Mekong Delta and Việt Nam as a whole, within the global rice industry, thereby contributing to international food security.

A highlight of the festival is the exhibition space titled 'The Rice Journey: From Past to Future,' which traces the evolution of Việt Nam's wet-rice civilisation, from traditional production methods to modern, technology-driven agriculture.

Featuring 12 distinct displays that integrate imagery, historical records, videos and 3D mapping technology, the exhibition explores the history of the rice plant, production milestones and the future trajectory of the rice sector.

The festival will also showcase achievements from various localities and businesses, alongside modern agricultural machinery, equipment and a diverse range of specialty, organic and high-quality rice varieties.

The event will host several thematic seminars and forums, such as 'The Future of Green Rice: Scientific, Technological, Digital, and Low-Emission Solutions'; 'Green Vietnamese Rice: Creating Value and Reaching the Global Stage'; and an FDI Promotion Forum.
These sessions will focus on identifying solutions to foster green production while enhancing the quality and added value of Vietnamese rice. - BIZHUB/VNS
